entities.summary: José Miguel "Tyson" Pérez Balbuena is a professional basketball player who currently plays for Unicaja in the Liga ACB. Standing at 2.02m tall, he plays as a power forward. Born in the Dominican Republic, he has been a full international for Spain since November 2020.
